sloka: एकस्य मरणं मे ऽस्तु मा भूत्सर्वविनाशनम् ।इति बुद्ध्या विनिश्चित्य राघवाय न्यवेदयत् ।। ७.१०५.९ ॥
transliteration: ekasya maraṇaṁ me 'stu mā bhūtsarvavināśanam ।iti buddhyā viniścitya rāghavāya nyavedayat ।। 7.105.9 ॥

translations.english: Deciding with his intellect that it was better for one person to die than for everyone to be destroyed, he reported this to Rama.
